eligibility_rule: Exact QE WFC/mix candidate only; current candidate stat matches the final lstat snapshot; same-run atomic-position XML parses with matching atom count; for NEB, latest .path trajectory parses with complete image coverage; fresh all-user queue has no active WorkDir/job-ID overlap. The 48 non-NEB WorkDir-mismatch mix files are eligible because their same-prefix QE XML is parseable and newer than every mix file, with explicit provenance warning. Eight zero-byte Cr-in-gap placeholders remain held. Restart-mode flags and SCF quality warnings alone do not override preserved coordinates; warnings remain attached to each row.
executor_default: read-only preflight; remote unlink requires explicit --execute
executor_safety_gates: read_queue rejects malformed rows and blank/unknown/nonabsolute WorkDir
openat traversal from allowlisted roots uses O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW for each parent component
fstatat with follow_symlinks=False compares exact candidate identity immediately before unlinkat
retained coordinate evidence is opened with O_NOFOLLOW and its SHA-256 checked
all-user squeue is recaptured once per eligible run root during preflight and again immediately before unlinking that root group
any overlap by candidate Slurm job ID or WorkDir aborts before that root is mutated
current exact QE restart-name set in each eligible run root must match the manifest
post-delete verification requires every manifest path absent, no unlisted QE WFC/mix candidates remaining, and coordinate hashes unchanged
